title.narrative: Implementing the Common Agenda to combat VAWG and promote inclusive peace building processes in Syria

description.narrative: The action aims at contributing to an inclusive, participatory and representative decision making in Syria, through combating VAWG and improving women¿s participation from local to international decision-making (Impact/Overall Objective). This will be done through empowering Syrian Human Rights (HRs) and Women¿s rights (WRs) defenders to play a leading role in combating VAWG and enhancing women¿s participation in peace building processes (Outcome 1), and improving access to services (prevention, social, health, legal) for victims or women and girls at risk of VAWG (Outcome 2).
